'''Theodorus "Theo" Henricus Maria Rasing''' (born 26 May 1953) is a Dutch professor of experimental physics at [[Radboud University Nijmegen]]. His expertise lies in the field of [[Magneto-optic effect|magneto-optics]]. He was a winner of the 2008 [[Spinoza Prize]].<ref name=nwo>{{cite web|url=http://www.nwo.nl/en/research-and-results/programmes/spinoza+prize/spinoza+laureates/overview+in+alphabetical+order/theo+rasing |title=Prof. Th.H.M. (Theo) Rasing |publisher=[[Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research]] |date=27 August 2014 |accessdate=12 September 2015}}</ref>

==Career==
Rasing was born on 26 May 1953 in [[Didam]].<ref name=nwo/> In 1976 he obtained a cum laude degree in physics from [[Radboud University Nijmegen]]. He obtained his doctorate from the same university in 1982. In 1997 he became professor at Radboud University Nijmegen.<ref name=nwo/>

In 2008 he was one of four winners of the Dutch [[Spinoza Prize]] and received a 1,5 million euro grant.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nwo.nl/en/research-and-results/programmes/spinoza+prize/spinoza+laureates/overview+by+year/2008 |title=NWO Spinoza Prize 2008 |publisher=Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research |date=27 August 2014 |accessdate=12 September 2015}}</ref> In 2013 Rasing won a 2,5 million euro Advanced Grant by the [[European Research Council]] for a research proposal titled 'magnetisation at its fastest'.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fom.nl/live/english/news/archives/pressreleases2013/artikel.pag?objectnumber=234126 |title=ERC Advanced Grant for Theo Rasing and Mikhail Katsnelson |publisher=FOM |date=21 August 2013 |accessdate=20 September 2015}}</ref>

Rasing was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 2010.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/11069 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200922050110/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/11069 |title=Theo Rasing |publisher=[[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] |date= |archive-date=22 September 2020}}</ref> In the same year he was made a Knight of the [[Order of the Netherlands Lion]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/leeuw-voor-apenonderzoeker~b19f0594/ |title=Leeuw voor apenonderzoeker |language=nl |publisher=Trouw |date=29 April 2010 |accessdate=6 November 2020}}</ref> Rasing was elected a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] in 2013.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Rasing_Theo |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171023230159/http://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Rasing_Theo |title=Theo Rasing |publisher=Academia Europaea |date= |archive-date=23 October 2017}}</ref>

In February 2015 the Dutch newspaper ''[[de Volkskrant]]'' listed Rasing second on a list of funds obtained by researchers.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Martijn van Calmthout |author2=Eline Huisman |author3=Sybren Kooistra |url=http://www.volkskrant.nl/wetenschap/het-prof-dr-dagobert-duck-effect~a3869714/ |title=Het prof. dr. Dagobert Duck-effect |language=Dutch |newspaper=[[de Volkskrant]] |date=21 February 2015 |accessdate=20 September 2015}}</ref>
